basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Madurai Project Technical Support Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of General Medicine at AIIMS Madurai is filling one Project Technical Support II post, open to OBC candidates only, in the ICMR-funded ICOPE – MTM research project under Principal Investigator Dr. Sabu Augustine. The post is for 18 months at Rs 20,000 + HRA 20% p.m. The essential qualification is 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering or equivalent) + five years' experience, or a B.Sc. in listed subjects + two years' experience, or postgraduation in those fields. Apply through the Google form by 5th December 2026, 05:00 p.m. Document verification, assessment and intervi

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Madurai Project Technical Support II at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Madurai

Feasibility and Effectiveness of Implementing Integrated Care for Older People (ICOPE) structured module through the Female Health Volunteers from "Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam" (MTM) on Elderly in Tamil Nadu [ICOPE – MTM] – a Type II Effectiveness Implementation Hybrid Design
Christian Medical College, Vellore; other project districts Madurai, Villupuram, Kanyakumari as needed

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Madurai
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Madurai describes itself as a statutory body established under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. This notice concerns a research project run from its Department of General Medicine, funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research. The project engages female health volunteers from "Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam" to deliver the ICOPE structured module to the elderly in Tamil Nadu.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The single vacancy is for the OBC category. The notice allows two alternative routes. The B.Sc. subjects listed are public health, medical social work, nursing, MLT, sociology, psychology, pharmacology, nutrition and dietetics, biochemistry, microbiology, allied health sciences, chemistry, physics and statistics. Previous experience in similar field/community-based projects, medical social background, health system related research projects or experience in training digital applications. Ability to speak, read and write in Tamil. The maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation for OBC candidates up to a maximum period of 3 (Three) years is admissible. The cut-off date for age is the last date for submission of applications. Educational qualifications and certificates must be from a recognized board/university. Experience is preferably from Government organizations and is counted after the date of the minimum essential qualification. Experience from reputed national/international organizations is also considered, and it must be from the relevant field/area. The candidate should be able to talk fluently in English and Tamil. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organization are not eligible. The applicant should not have been convicted by any court of law. Where the result of the qualifying exam is declared after the closing date, the candidature stands cancelled. Qualification and experience obtained after the closing date are not considered. Applicants must not belong to the Creamy Layer under the Government of India criteria cited in the notice (DoPT O.M. No. 36012/22/93-Estt. (SCT) dated 08/09/93, modified by OM No. 36033/3/2004 Estt. (Res.) dated 09/03/2004). The certificate must be valid for employment in Central Government Institutions and must show non-creamy layer status. It should have been issued between 2nd November 2025 and the last date of receipt of application. The Sub-caste must match the Central List of OBC, failing which the candidature as OBC will not be considered. The Central List can be seen at http://www.ncbc.nic.in/User_Panel/CentralListStateView.aspx . Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT / Engineering or equivalent) + Five Years' Experience in relevant subject / field. OR Three Years Graduate degree in Science – B.Sc. (listed subjects) + two years' experience in relevant subject, or postgraduation in the above fields.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs 20,000 + HRA 20% p.m. The notice says the rates of emoluments/stipend are project specific and may vary according to the sanction of the funding agency. The total duration is 18 months. The first appointment is for 11 months, and the contract will be renewed based on performance evaluation by the project investigator with the approval of the Director. Duration may be extended or curtailed based on the instructions of the funding agency. Continuation depends on performance, project tenure, availability of funds, functional requirements and approval of the Competent Authority. The post is a tenure job for a fixed duration, purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Expected period of joining (tentative): fourth week of December 2026. Leave, Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession, Medical claim, Staff Quarters and other facilities applicable to regular ICMR / AIIMS Madurai staff are not admissible. Travelling Allowance is provided to project staff as admissible under existing guidelines.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Madurai Project Technical Support II Job Description
content_sections.text: Plan data collection for field and community-based surveys. Coordinate with scientist and technical team for app development and field level testing. Data collection in the community and public health facilities. Training of women volunteers along with investigators. Perform any other work assigned by the PI/ Co-PI/ Supervisory officers. Selected candidates are expected to work from Christian Medical College, Vellore. They are expected to travel extensively within the posted district for data collection in the selected blocks. They can be posted to the other project districts (Madurai, Villupuram, Kanyakumari) according to project needs.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Madurai Project Technical Support II
content_sections.text: Fill the application form using the Google form link https://shorturl.at/uliFh (the notice also prints a QR code for it). The format is Annexure I of the notice. Submit the duly filled form online with a recent passport size colour photograph and a biodata/CV. Submit the duly filled and signed Undertaking (Annexure-II) along with the application form. Submit all relevant documents, duly self-attested, online as a single PDF. Submit before 5th December 2026, 05:00 p.m. Late, delayed or incomplete applications will be rejected without any communication. A candidate applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post using the same Google form. For queries, write to [email protected] . Proof of age. OBC-NCL (updated) certificate in the requisite proforma, if applicable. Photo ID (Aadhar Card/Indian Passport/PAN Card/Driving License). Relevant degree and experience certificates.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria are shortlisted and called for an assessment and interview. The email about the final date goes only to shortlisted candidates. The preliminary assessment includes a written exam and a hands-on exercise, and those shortlisted in it are interviewed. Video-conference assessment or interview requests will not be entertained. Assessment syllabus: objective type questions on research, health system and non-communicable diseases, plus hands-on exercises on data management, analysis and reporting. Final grading is based on experience in research work/relevant field-based project, the written exam and hands-on exercise, and the interview score. Only candidates scoring top 10 marks in the assessment are shortlisted for interview. A tie in final marks is decided by seniority on date of birth. The decision of the selection committee and Principal Investigator is final. The venue (tentative) is the Board Room, Project Cell Office, Thoppur, Austinpatti (post), All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Madurai - 625008. Reporting is on 9th December 2026 at 09:00 a.m. No TA/DA is paid for the interview, and candidates arrange transport and accommodation themselves. Candidates must bring: Govt issued ID (Aadhar/PAN/Passport/Driving Licence), proof of date of birth and caste. Reservation category certificate (updated OBC-NCL). Original certificates for verification of educational qualifications. Experience certificate from previous workplaces. One set of xerox copies of qualifying and experience certificates. Passport size photos (two). Birth Certificate / SSLC.
